About us

Introducing Leeds

Innovative learning and world-leading research in an iconic city. Find out what makes us a world top-100 university.

Introducing Leeds audio described video Video transcript: Introducing Leeds Watch Introducing Leeds on Bilibili

Introducing Leeds

Student stories

Life at Leeds

Our students share what it’s like to study at Leeds, from courses to campus life.

Chat to students

Romy's story

I will leave Leeds feeling very excited for my future.

Joceline Kamajaya

The University offers a lot of support to increase employability.

Emilio’s story

The course exceeded my expectations from the moment I started.

Pragya Sharma

Leeds has something for everyone, making it easy to feel at home.

At Leeds, I learned from experts, who were developing the research that I was studying.
Katie, Law LLB

Research and innovation

World-leading research to shape a better future

Our researchers work across disciplines, pushing the frontiers of knowledge and discovery to explore complex problems and find solutions.

Explore research

News

Latest news

The latest stories, press office contacts and our news archive.

News

Queen Elizabeth Prize for Higher and Further Education

The University is awarded one of the UK’s most prestigious education honours for its 150 years of textile research.

Health

Major study to track impacts of childhood blood disorders

The lifelong effects of rare blood disorder diagnoses in childhood are being analysed in a first-of-its-kind study.

Environment

Twenty-year plan to restore nature and support fell farming

The Upper Duddon Landscape Recovery project brings together farmers, environmental organisations and the local community.

Cultural and creative industries

Class still determines who makes a career in TV

Research highlights the need to build real routes to career stability in TV, tackling financial risk and insecurity.

Working with our region

Working together for the region

The Civic Exchange unites researchers, policymakers and communities to create new opportunities for lasting impact.
